JAPAN AIR LINES

She speaks your language. Happy Talk.
Wherever you fly the world around.
The comforts of Japan
go with you
on JAL routes east or west
around the globe.
You're not long aboard a sleek JAL Jet
Courier when you realize your gracious hostess
understands you, whatever your language.
That's because she speaks Happy Talk.
It's the friendly way Japanese have of expres-
sing themselves and making you feel at home.
And that, after all, is what Japan Air
Lines is all about ... a unique atmosphere aloft,
happy and serene as only your smiling JAL
kimono-clad hostess can make it.
She flies almost everywhere.
Transpacific... transatlantic...over the
Pole...throughout Asia - reaching more
than 30 of the world's great cities.
Won't you fly with her? It's
time you learned another language.
On JAL you're more than a
passenger. You're an honored guest.
